coevolution.zh: 四、模型与 Harness 协同进化

papers.title: Gödel Machines
papers.summary_zh: 自指式自改进的理论原型：只有在证明改写有益后才改。几乎所有 RSI 论文的引言都会提到。
papers.summary_en: A theoretical prototype of self-referential self-improvement: rewrite only after proving the change beneficial. Almost every RSI paper mentions it in the introduction.

papers.title: STOP: Self-Taught Optimizer
papers.summary_zh: 让「改进代码的程序」去改进自己，是 LLM 时代递归自改进脚手架的起点；也讨论了绕过沙箱等安全问题。
papers.summary_en: A program that improves code improves itself, marking a starting point for recursive self-improvement scaffolds in the LLM era; it also discusses safety issues such as bypassing sandboxes.

papers.title: DSPy
papers.summary_zh: 把「编译」提示流水线作为优化问题，是文本优化器一系的代表基线。
papers.summary_en: Treats the “compilation” of prompt pipelines as an optimization problem, serving as a representative baseline for text optimizers.

papers.title: Voyager
papers.summary_zh: 技能以代码形式累积并复用，是技能、记忆类 Harness 演化的前身。
papers.summary_en: Accumulates and reuses skills as code, a precursor to harness evolution through skills and memory.

papers.title: ADAS: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
papers.summary_zh: Meta Agent Search：元 Agent 在代码空间里不断写出新 Agent，并保留档案。「Harness 即代码」的搜索范式从这里开始。
papers.summary_en: Meta Agent Search: a meta agent continually writes new agents in code space and maintains an archive. The search paradigm of “harness as code” starts here.

papers.title: AFlow
papers.summary_zh: 用 MCTS 搜索代码表示的工作流，是工作流级自动优化的标准基线。
papers.summary_en: Uses MCTS to search workflows represented as code, a standard baseline for automated workflow optimization.

papers.title: Gödel Agent
papers.summary_zh: 让 Agent 在运行时检查并修改自己的代码，含改进逻辑本身，是自指式 Agent 的代表实现。
papers.summary_en: Lets an agent inspect and modify its own code at runtime, including the improvement logic itself; a representative implementation of self-referential agents.

papers.title: SICA: A Self-Improving Coding Agent
papers.summary_zh: 执行者与改进者是同一个 Agent，直接改自己的 Python 代码；「自改」路线的典型对比对象。
papers.summary_en: The executor and improver are the same agent, directly modifying its own Python code; a typical comparison for the self-modification approach.

papers.title: Darwin Gödel Machine
papers.summary_zh: 用开放式演化档案替代「证明有益」，在 SWE-bench 与 Polyglot 上持续自改。复现前先看 Reflections on Trusting Trust, Revisited（容器 git 历史可泄露答案）。
papers.summary_en: Replaces “prove beneficial” with an open-ended evolutionary archive, continually modifying itself on SWE-bench and Polyglot. Before reproducing it, read Reflections on Trusting Trust, Revisited: container git history can leak answers.

papers.title: AlphaEvolve
papers.summary_zh: 不改 Harness，但其「提案—评估—档案」循环被大量 Harness 演化工作沿用。
papers.summary_en: Does not modify the harness, but its proposal–evaluation–archive loop is reused by many harness evolution studies.

papers.title: ACE: Agentic Context Engineering
papers.summary_zh: 把上下文当成持续演化的 playbook，是最常对比的上下文类基线。
papers.summary_en: Treats context as a continually evolving playbook, one of the most frequently used context baselines.

papers.title: Huxley-Gödel Machine
papers.summary_zh: 用谱系级的元生产力指标指导自改搜索，是 DGM 路线的重要改进；HGM-Dual 直接建立在它之上。
papers.summary_en: Uses a lineage-level meta-productivity metric to guide self-modification search, an important improvement on the DGM approach; HGM-Dual builds directly on it.

papers.title: Meta-Harness
papers.summary_zh: 编码 Agent 通过文件系统读取所有历史候选的源码、分数和完整轨迹来搜索 Harness。窗口内最常见的对比基线。
papers.summary_en: A coding agent searches for harnesses by reading source code, scores, and full trajectories of all historical candidates through the filesystem. The most common comparison baseline in the covered period.
papers.result_zh: 一个数学推理 Harness 在 5 个留出模型上平均 +4.7 分。
papers.result_en: A mathematical reasoning harness averages +4.7 points on 5 held-out models.

papers.title: AHE: Agentic Harness Engineering
papers.summary_zh: 三个「可观测性」支柱：组件文件化、轨迹分层蒸馏、每次编辑附带可证伪的预测，下一轮核验。
papers.summary_en: Three pillars of observability: components as files, hierarchical trajectory distillation, and a falsifiable prediction attached to each edit for verification in the next round.
papers.result_zh: Terminal-Bench 2 pass@1 十轮从 69.7% 到 77.0%，超过 Codex-CLI；跨模型家族迁移 +5.1–10.1pp。
papers.result_en: Terminal-Bench 2 pass@1 rises from 69.7% to 77.0% over ten rounds, surpassing Codex-CLI; transfer across model families yields +5.1–10.1pp.

papers.title: DemoEvolve
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏奖励的长程随机环境里，用人类示范轨迹指导编辑者诊断和定位 Harness 问题。
papers.summary_en: In long-horizon stochastic environments with sparse rewards, human demonstration trajectories guide an editor to diagnose and locate harness problems.
papers.result_zh: Liar's Dice 上自演化可行；Balatro 上自演化被噪声误导，加示范后同预算下更好。
papers.result_en: Self-evolution works on Liar's Dice; on Balatro, noise misleads self-evolution, while adding demonstrations performs better at the same budget.

papers.title: Self-Harness: Harnesses That Improve Themselves
papers.summary_zh: 弱点挖掘 → 最小化修改提案 → 回归测试后才接受；不依赖更强的外部模型。
papers.summary_en: Mine weaknesses → propose minimal edits → accept only after regression tests; does not rely on a stronger external model.

papers.title: TTHE: Test-Time Harness Evolution
papers.summary_zh: 测试时只用无标签执行轨迹演化候选 Harness 种群；求解器、提议器、裁判共用一个冻结模型，各有不同 Harness。
papers.summary_en: Evolves a population of candidate harnesses at test time using only unlabeled execution trajectories; the solver, proposer, and judge share one frozen model, each with a different harness.
papers.result_zh: BIRD 执行准确率 12.7%→48.7%（十次投票基线 16.0%）；演化出的 Harness 可迁移到其他模型。
papers.result_en: BIRD execution accuracy 12.7%→48.7% (ten-vote baseline 16.0%); the evolved harness transfers to other models.

papers.title: HarnessBank: Semantic Gene-Bank Search with Gated Verification for Agent-Harness Self-Evolution
papers.summary_zh: 任务 Agent 与独立演化 Agent 分离；用语义坐标组织「Harness 基因库」做质量多样性搜索，分阶段筛选候选以减少完整评估。
papers.summary_en: Separates the task agent from an independent evolution agent; organizes a “harness gene bank” by semantic coordinates for quality-diversity search, screening candidates in stages to reduce full evaluations.
papers.result_zh: 针对搜索坍缩、任务过拟合和不可验证的提升；定量结果待细读。
papers.result_en: Targets search collapse, task overfitting, and unverifiable gains; quantitative results need close reading.

papers.title: RHI: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
papers.summary_zh: Harness 写成提示级规范，用自身修订历史上的成对反馈迭代；收益主要来自上下文管理与 Agent 间信息流。被递归修改的是任务 Harness，不是改进器。
papers.summary_en: Expresses the harness as a prompt-level specification and iterates using paired feedback from its own revision history; gains mainly come from context management and information flow between agents. The task harness is recursively modified, not the improver.
papers.result_zh: 30 个合成 ML 研究任务上，低推理强度 Agent 超过最高推理强度设置，成本最多降 60%。
papers.result_en: On 30 synthetic ML research tasks, a low-reasoning-effort agent exceeds the highest-reasoning-effort setting, reducing cost by up to 60%.

papers.title: DREvo: Distilling Recalibrated Historical Experience for Harness Self-Evolution
papers.summary_zh: 把历史证据锚定到函数级，随当前版本重新校准其有效性，再蒸馏成按角色区分的搜索意图。
papers.summary_en: Anchors historical evidence at the function level, recalibrates its validity against the current version, then distills it into search intentions differentiated by role.
papers.result_zh: 覆盖化学与法律推理、TB2.0、SWE-bench Verified；演化曲线比 Meta-Harness 平稳，提议器上下文保持在约 2.9K token。
papers.result_en: Covers chemistry and legal reasoning, TB2.0, and SWE-bench Verified; evolution curves are steadier than Meta-Harness, while proposer context stays around 2.9K token.

papers.title: DarwinX: Evolving Agent Harnesses Through Natural Selection
papers.summary_zh: Harness 种群选择；「保持并扩展」契约只接受在已评估任务上不退化的变体；归档保留多条谱系并合并互补的专家 Harness。不退化只在有限评估集上检查。
papers.summary_en: Harness population selection: a “preserve and expand” contract accepts only variants that do not regress on evaluated tasks; an archive retains multiple lineages and merges complementary expert harnesses. Non-regression is checked only on a finite evaluation set.
papers.result_zh: TB2.1 75.5%→83.2%；TerminalWorld 留出集 68.3%；WebArena-Infinity 43.5%→93.0%；不加修改迁移到 SWE-bench Verified。
papers.result_en: TB2.1 75.5%→83.2%; TerminalWorld held-out set 68.3%; WebArena-Infinity 43.5%→93.0%; transfers to SWE-bench Verified without modification.

papers.title: Mendel Gödel Machine: Recursive Self-Improving Coding Agents via Comparative Evolution
papers.summary_zh: DGM 路线：同一 Agent 跨任务的表现比较，加上不同谱系在同一任务上的轨迹比较，驱动变异与杂交。
papers.summary_en: The DGM approach: comparisons of the same agent across tasks, combined with trajectory comparisons of different lineages on the same task, drive mutation and crossover.
papers.result_zh: 证明收敛更快；SWE-bench、Polyglot 上超过单轨迹基线。
papers.result_en: Demonstrates faster convergence; exceeds single-trajectory baselines on SWE-bench and Polyglot.

papers.title: Ouroboros: A Self-Developing Coding Harness with Reviewed Core Evolution
papers.summary_zh: 工具、提示、上下文组装、核心代码经审查提交后成为运行时；护栏在演化压力下保持权威。
papers.summary_en: Tools, prompts, context assembly, and core code become the runtime after reviewed commits; guardrails retain authority under evolutionary pressure.
papers.result_zh: TB2.1 86.74%（轨迹审计后），OSWorld-Verified 90.69%（冻结快照）；公开部署 Hope 持续演化 161 天。
papers.result_en: TB2.1 86.74% (after trajectory auditing), OSWorld-Verified 90.69% (frozen snapshot); the public deployment Hope evolves continuously for 161 days.

papers.title: Evo-Harness
papers.summary_zh: 在线 Harness 学习：任务顺序到来，把一次性执行上下文编译成 Markdown 技能。与 Harness Updating ≠ Benefit 同实验室。
papers.summary_en: Online harness learning: as tasks arrive sequentially, compiles one-off execution context into Markdown skills. From the same lab as Harness Updating ≠ Benefit.
papers.result_zh: 5 个 benchmark 全部提升；模型自判反馈会导致退化，强求解器受益更多。
papers.result_en: Improves on all 5 benchmarks; model self-judgment feedback causes regression, while stronger solvers benefit more.

papers.title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
papers.summary_zh: 离线 mini-batch：失败轨迹深度诊断 → 覆盖提示、工具、中间件的结构化代码补丁 → 验证集与 EvoDAG 做泛化感知选择。理解完整工程闭环的入口。
papers.summary_en: Offline mini-batches: deep diagnosis of failure trajectories → structured code patches covering prompts, tools, and middleware → generalization-aware selection using a validation set and EvoDAG. An entry point to the complete engineering loop.
papers.result_zh: GAIA2、SWE-Bench Pro、TB2.0 相对基础 Harness +9.0/+9.6/+10.0pp，比最强自动化基线高 7.4/4.4/6.7pp；消融支持深度调试、定向修改、泛化选择三要素。
papers.result_en: On GAIA2, SWE-Bench Pro, and TB2.0: +9.0/+9.6/+10.0pp over the base harness, and 7.4/4.4/6.7pp above the strongest automated baseline; ablations support deep debugging, targeted edits, and generalization-aware selection.

papers.title: StarHarness: Evolving Harnesses with Stratified Search for Enterprise Environments
papers.summary_zh: 按基础 Harness 的失败行为分层构造演化池；提议器可见的搜索任务、不可见的选择任务、最终留出任务三者分开。
papers.summary_en: Builds a stratified evolution pool from the base harness’s failure behaviors; separates search tasks visible to the proposer, hidden selection tasks, and final held-out tasks.
papers.result_zh: ITBench SRE 等三个企业环境上，每个接受 4–12 次修改后全基准 +20–35pp；演化外任务上收益仍在，不重新演化即可迁移到 GPT 与 Qwen 系列。
papers.result_en: Across three enterprise environments including ITBench SRE, each accepts 4–12 edits and gains +20–35pp across the full benchmark; gains persist on tasks outside evolution, and transfer to GPT and Qwen families requires no re-evolution.

papers.title: Recuris
papers.summary_zh: 固定 Meta-Agent：工作记忆跟踪进度，经验记忆供技能，对技能记忆做局部、经验证的更新。
papers.summary_en: A fixed Meta-Agent: working memory tracks progress, experience memory provides skills, and skill memory receives local, verified updates.
papers.result_zh: 37 组中 35 组提升；tau-bench 上 Opus 5 +15.6 到 87.9%。
papers.result_en: Improves in 35 of 37 groups; on tau-bench, Opus 5 gains +15.6 to reach 87.9%.

papers.title: ModularRSI: Modular and Generalizable Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
papers.summary_zh: Harness 拆成执行循环、工具使用、观测管理、上下文管理、完成检测五模块，受限范围内独立演化再合并；成功与失败轨迹对比；2,000 个与评测不相交的演化任务。
papers.summary_en: Splits the harness into five modules: execution loop, tool use, observation management, context management, and completion detection; evolves each within a restricted scope, then merges them; contrasts successful and failed trajectories; uses 2,000 evolution tasks disjoint from evaluation.
papers.result_zh: TB2.0 47.57→52.43，SWE-Bench Verified 73.40→76.45；跨模型迁移有效。
papers.result_en: TB2.0 47.57→52.43, SWE-Bench Verified 73.40→76.45; cross-model transfer is effective.

papers.title: EMHO
papers.summary_zh: 具身场景：冻结 VLM，从稀疏、弱诊断性的交互反馈中修改 Harness，并支持合并为共享 Harness。
papers.summary_en: Embodied setting: freezes the VLM, modifies the harness from sparse interaction feedback with weak diagnostic value, and supports merging into a shared harness.
papers.result_zh: 定量结果待细读。
papers.result_en: Quantitative results need close reading.

papers.title: RiseHarness: Harness Self-Evolution for Long-Horizon Terminal Agents
papers.summary_zh: 针对重复运行时时成时败的任务：结合 Agent 轨迹与运行时内部追踪，用 Harness Handbook 把行为映射到源码，并检索其他框架的实现作参考。
papers.summary_en: Targets tasks with inconsistent success across repeated runs: combines agent trajectories and internal runtime traces, maps behavior to source code using a Harness Handbook, and retrieves implementations from other frameworks as references.
papers.result_zh: Pass@1 与 Pass^4（四次全过的任务比例）都提高，Pass@4 只小幅上升，收益主要在可靠性；可迁移到未参与演化的基准。
papers.result_en: Both Pass@1 and Pass^4 (the fraction of tasks passing all four runs) improve, while Pass@4 rises only slightly; gains mainly concern reliability and transfer to benchmarks not used in evolution.

papers.title: Object-Oriented Harness: Evolving Agent Harnesses through Object-Oriented Design
papers.summary_zh: 演化出 Harness 类的继承层次，专门化版本继承基类或已有子类；测试时路由器按任务和基础执行的证据选版本。
papers.summary_en: Evolves an inheritance hierarchy of harness classes, with specialized versions inheriting from the base class or existing subclasses; a test-time router chooses versions using the task and evidence from base execution.
papers.result_zh: 对比 Meta-Harness、AHE 与 Adaptive Auto-Harness，在三个长程基准上主指标都最高（三次运行均值）。
papers.result_en: Compared with Meta-Harness, AHE, and Adaptive Auto-Harness, achieves the highest primary metric on all three long-horizon benchmarks (means over three runs).

papers.title: HGM-Dual: Lineage-Aware Guided Agent Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Planning
papers.summary_zh: 建立在 HGM 之上：把祖先改了什么、哪些行为改善或回退组织成谱系上下文；每个父版本同时生成开放探索子代和针对主要约束违例的专门子代。
papers.summary_en: Builds on HGM: organizes ancestor edits and behavioral improvements or regressions into lineage context; each parent produces both an open-exploration child and a specialized child targeting the main constraint violation.
papers.result_zh: 长程规划任务上比最强基线最多高 14.45%（相对）；用 HGM 变体 1/2 到 1/4 的评估预算达到相同最终性能。
papers.result_en: On long-horizon planning tasks, exceeds the strongest baseline by up to 14.45% (relative); matches the final performance of HGM variants with 1/2 to 1/4 of their evaluation budget.

papers.title: HARBOR
papers.summary_zh: 不改代码，而是在固定组件的 Harness 配置空间上做成本感知的贝叶斯优化。
papers.summary_en: Performs cost-aware Bayesian optimization over a harness configuration space with fixed components, without changing code.
papers.result_zh: 与 Meta-Harness 类「改代码」路线互补，可作为配置搜索基线。
papers.result_en: Complements code-editing approaches such as Meta-Harness and can serve as a configuration-search baseline.

papers.title: HarnessCompass: Guiding Automatic Harness Evolution toward Generalizable and Effective Agent Harnesses
papers.summary_zh: 三条原则：泛化门控限制任务特化修改；第一人称「主动反馈」补充轨迹证据；组件分轨优化再整合，减少相互干扰。
papers.summary_en: Three principles: generalization gates restrict task-specific edits; first-person “active feedback” supplements trajectory evidence; components are optimized on separate tracks and then integrated to reduce interference.
papers.result_zh: 报告 SWE-bench Verified 五轮提升并检验跨任务、跨模型迁移；但 CHASE 在 OfficeQA 上发现其门控不保证留出提升。
papers.result_en: Reports improvement over five rounds on SWE-bench Verified and tests cross-task and cross-model transfer; however, CHASE finds on OfficeQA that its gates do not guarantee held-out gains.

papers.title: HarnessEvolve: Learning from Reference Trajectories for Reliable Agent Self-Evolution
papers.summary_zh: 把「给定标准答案后重放」得到的参考轨迹与失败轨迹对齐做信用分配；质量门过滤答案硬编码与提示膨胀，性能门防遗忘。
papers.summary_en: Aligns reference trajectories obtained by replaying with standard answers against failed trajectories for credit assignment; a quality gate filters hardcoded answers and prompt bloat, while a performance gate prevents forgetting.
papers.result_zh: 消融：去掉参考轨迹后 CloudCoreNetwork-QA 从 86.9 跌到 57.8。
papers.result_en: Ablation: removing reference trajectories drops CloudCoreNetwork-QA from 86.9 to 57.8.

papers.title: SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness
papers.summary_zh: 在大量环境中扩展 auto-research 循环，筛选 token 效率机制；候选冻结后才做留出评估。
papers.summary_en: Scales the auto-research loop across many environments to select token-efficient mechanisms; held-out evaluation occurs only after candidates are frozen.
papers.result_zh: EdgeBench 性能与 Pi 相当，token 流量降 44.7–49.0%，API 成本降约三分之一。
papers.result_en: Matches Pi on EdgeBench, reducing token traffic by 44.7–49.0% and API cost by about one third.

papers.title: Bad Genius: Counterfactual-Guided Harness Evolution Beyond Task-Specific Shortcuts (CHASE)
papers.summary_zh: 用反事实挑战者拦截只对特定任务有效的「捷径」编辑，按最差情况选择最终 Harness。
papers.summary_en: Uses counterfactual challengers to block “shortcut” edits that work only for specific tasks, selecting the final harness by worst-case performance.
papers.result_zh: OfficeQA Pro V2 达 30.37%，最差情况得分最高；适合作为「泛化」论点的对照。
papers.result_en: Reaches 30.37% on OfficeQA Pro V2 with the highest worst-case score; useful as a comparison for claims about generalization.

papers.title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
papers.summary_zh: 退火编辑预算 + critic 筛掉 benchmark 特化提案 + pruner 删掉无效改动。
papers.summary_en: Anneals the editing budget, uses a critic to filter benchmark-specific proposals, and a pruner to remove ineffective edits.
papers.result_zh: 五个分布外基准上迁移优于 Meta-Harness、AHE、TTHE、HarnessX，最高 +4.7；单任务 token 2.42M（无正则演化为 3.80M）。
papers.result_en: Transfers better than Meta-Harness, AHE, TTHE, and HarnessX on five out-of-distribution benchmarks, by up to +4.7; per-task token use is 2.42M (3.80M for unregularized evolution).

papers.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
papers.summary_zh: 无标签：用模型生成的测试评价候选，不访问标准答案或官方测试；按性能与成本的不同偏好产出 lite、medium、heavy 三档。
papers.summary_en: Label-free: evaluates candidates with model-generated tests, without accessing standard answers or official tests; produces lite, medium, and heavy tiers for different performance–cost preferences.
papers.result_zh: GPT-5.5 + Codex 配置下，heavy 相对 RHO 平均通过率 +2.0pp，单任务成本降 26.1%。
papers.result_en: With GPT-5.5 + Codex, heavy improves average pass rate by +2.0pp over RHO and reduces per-task cost by 26.1%.

papers.title: MaD-RSI: Model-as-Data for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
papers.summary_zh: 把多个异构模型的失败轨迹当作证据，直接优化一个共享 Harness，把跨模型泛化变成优化目标。
papers.summary_en: Uses failure trajectories from multiple heterogeneous models as evidence to directly optimize one shared harness, making cross-model generalization an optimization objective.
papers.result_zh: 摘要称泛化更好、成本更低，未给出数字。
papers.result_en: The abstract claims better generalization and lower costs without providing numbers.

papers.title: Task-CoEvolve: Efficient Harness Optimization via Adaptive Validation Task Selection
papers.summary_zh: 自适应选择最能区分候选 Harness 的验证任务，并校正非均匀采样对全集性能估计的偏差；与搜索侧提效正交。
papers.summary_en: Adaptively selects validation tasks that best distinguish candidate harnesses and corrects bias from nonuniform sampling in full-set performance estimates; orthogonal to improving search efficiency.
papers.result_zh: 目标是降低每个候选的评估成本；定量结果待细读。
papers.result_en: Aims to reduce evaluation cost per candidate; quantitative results need close reading.

papers.title: ECDYSIS: Efficient and Effective Training of Runtime Harnesses for LLM Agents
papers.summary_zh: 用「失败是否跨任务反复出现」区分模型局限与 Harness 本身的缺陷，只让反复出现的 Harness 缺陷驱动持久修改。
papers.summary_en: Uses whether failures recur across tasks to distinguish model limitations from defects in the harness itself; only recurring harness defects drive persistent edits.
papers.result_zh: 演化出的 Harness 推理准确率比现有演化方法高 18.56%，训练最多快 1.84 倍。
papers.result_en: The evolved harness has reasoning accuracy 18.56% higher than existing evolution methods, with training up to 1.84 times faster.

papers.title: ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization
papers.summary_zh: 把反复出现的失败抽象成动态增加的失败模式，用非平稳多臂赌博机在已知弱点与新场景间分配任务，课程随 Harness 一起变。
papers.summary_en: Abstracts recurring failures into a dynamically growing set of failure patterns and uses a nonstationary multi-armed bandit to allocate tasks between known weaknesses and new scenarios; the curriculum changes with the harness.
papers.result_zh: 同一优化器下，相比事先固定任务顺序，GAIA2 与 TB2.0 测试 Pass@1 分别 +4.4、+7.5pp。
papers.result_en: With the same optimizer, test Pass@1 on GAIA2 and TB2.0 improves by +4.4 and +7.5pp respectively over a task order fixed in advance.

papers.title: Forging More Tasks into Better Harnesses: Agentic Harness Evolution via Successive Scale Racing (SSR)
papers.summary_zh: 按任务质量与覆盖构造多种证据组合，各生成候选 Harness，再用小预算逐轮竞赛淘汰。
papers.summary_en: Constructs multiple evidence combinations based on task quality and coverage, generates a candidate harness from each, then eliminates candidates through successive small-budget competitions.
papers.result_zh: 动机：AHE 在 80 个任务时最高 63.0%，扩到 200 个反而降到 57.7%；SSR 在任务池从 40 扩到 200 时通过率持续上升。
papers.result_en: Motivation: AHE peaks at 63.0% with 80 tasks but falls to 57.7% when expanded to 200; SSR’s pass rate keeps increasing as the task pool grows from 40 to 200.

papers.title: Hyperagents (DGM-H)
papers.summary_zh: 任务 Agent 与元 Agent 合并成同一个可编辑程序，元层修改程序本身也可改。
papers.summary_en: Merges the task agent and meta agent into a single editable program; the program that makes meta-level edits can itself be modified.
papers.result_zh: 在编码、论文评审、机器人奖励设计、奥赛数学批改上都超过 DGM；元层改进可跨领域迁移。最常引的元改进基线。
papers.result_en: Exceeds DGM in coding, paper reviewing, robot reward design, and Olympiad mathematics grading; meta-level improvements transfer across domains. The most frequently cited meta-improvement baseline.

papers.title: The Last Harness You'll Ever Build
papers.summary_zh: 两层框架：内层针对单任务优化工作 Agent；外层 Meta-Evolution Agent 优化评估器、演化策略、信息流等「演化循环本身」。
papers.summary_en: A two-level framework: the inner loop optimizes a worker agent for a single task; an outer Meta-Evolution Agent optimizes the “evolution loop itself,” including evaluators, evolution strategies, and information flow.
papers.result_zh: 概念清晰，适合引为两层形式化的来源；定量结果待细读。
papers.result_en: Conceptually clear and useful as a source for two-level formalization; quantitative results need close reading.
papers.short_title: The Last Harness You'll Ever Build

papers.title: MetaSkill-Evolve
papers.summary_zh: 每个分支带一个「元技能」，参数化分析、检索、分配、提案、演化五个 Agent；任务技能快循环、元技能慢循环。
papers.summary_en: Each branch carries a “meta-skill” that parameterizes five agents for analysis, retrieval, allocation, proposal, and evolution; task skills have a fast loop and meta-skills a slow loop.
papers.result_zh: 冻结 Gemma-4 31B：OfficeQA +23.54、SealQA +16.09、ALFWorld +1.92；元技能在任务技能进入平台期后最有用。
papers.result_en: Frozen Gemma-4 31B: OfficeQA +23.54, SealQA +16.09, ALFWorld +1.92; meta-skills are most useful after task skills plateau.

papers.title: Hierarchical Self-Improvement: A Framework for Task-Specific Evolvable Agent Harnesses
papers.summary_zh: 同一个冻结模型在三个层级工作：任务 Harness、改写它的演化器、改写演化器策略的元演化器；最外层锚点冻结。单谱系设计便于归因。
papers.summary_en: The same frozen model works at three levels: a task harness, an evolver that rewrites it, and a meta-evolver that rewrites the evolver’s strategy; the outermost anchor stays frozen. A single-lineage design aids attribution.
papers.result_zh: 报告了边界：超出骨干能力的任务（NLE）上没有提升。
papers.result_en: Reports a boundary: no improvement on tasks beyond the backbone’s capabilities (NLE).

papers.title: Harness-R1
papers.summary_zh: 把「根据失败轨迹编辑可执行 Harness」当作策略，冷启动 SFT 后用 GRPO 在线训练。
papers.summary_en: Treats editing an executable harness from failure trajectories as a policy, using online GRPO training after cold-start SFT.
papers.result_zh: WebShop、ALFWorld、DBBench 上把 Qwen3.5-9B 从 44.3% 提到 53.6%。
papers.result_en: Raises Qwen3.5-9B from 44.3% to 53.6% on WebShop, ALFWorld, and DBBench.

papers.title: Meta^n
papers.summary_zh: 元操作固定，只递归它的输入，层数由收敛决定。
papers.summary_en: Keeps the meta-operation fixed and recurses only over its input; convergence determines the number of levels.
papers.result_zh: 八类 benchmark 超过已有自改进 Agent；ARC-AGI-2 唯一得分高于零。
papers.result_en: Exceeds existing self-improving agents across eight benchmark categories; the only score above zero on ARC-AGI-2.

papers.title: MetaRSI / RSI²
papers.summary_zh: 用统一 Loop Kernel 把模型、数据、Harness 三类改进写成可调度算子，元层修订调度策略。
papers.summary_en: A unified Loop Kernel expresses improvements to models, data, and harnesses as schedulable operators; the meta level revises the scheduling strategy.
papers.result_zh: 中文媒体报道：3B 激活参数模型平均 +10.9 分；须核对正文。
papers.result_en: Chinese media reports: a model with 3B active parameters gains +10.9 points on average; the full text must be checked.

papers.title: Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation
papers.summary_zh: 用修订后 Harness 的任务表现作奖励，强化学习训练 Harness 提案者。
papers.summary_en: Uses task performance under the revised harness as a reward to train a harness proposer with reinforcement learning.
papers.result_zh: 训练后的提案者在多轮测试时适配中持续改进，并能泛化到新的适配上下文；定量结果待细读。
papers.result_en: The trained proposer keeps improving over multiple rounds of test-time adaptation and generalizes to new adaptation contexts; quantitative results need close reading.
papers.short_title: Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation

papers.title: AIDE²: Recursive Self-Improvement of AI Research Agents
papers.summary_zh: 研究 Agent 改自己的代码，提升的正是它做研究（即改进）的效率；用隐藏评测做选择。
papers.summary_en: A research agent edits its own code, improving its efficiency at research, which is itself improvement; selection uses hidden evaluations.
papers.result_zh: 8 天 7 次连续改进，迁移到 4 个留出 benchmark；奖励作弊率 55% 降到 32%。
papers.result_en: 7 consecutive improvements in 8 days, transferring to 4 held-out benchmarks; reward hacking falls from 55% to 32%.

papers.title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches for Agent Harness Optimization
papers.summary_zh: 把搜索分成多个分支，每个分支有自己演化中的开发子集和提案策略；部署版本与路由配置只按开发集选。
papers.summary_en: Splits search into multiple branches, each with its own evolving development subset and proposal strategy; deployment versions and routing configurations are selected only on the development set.
papers.result_zh: 相对 Meta-Harness：奥赛数学 +34.8%、TB2.0 +11.6%、SWE-bench Lite +3.8%（相对提升）。
papers.result_en: Relative to Meta-Harness: Olympiad mathematics +34.8%, TB2.0 +11.6%, SWE-bench Lite +3.8% (relative gains).
papers.short_title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches for Agent Harness Optimization

papers.title: MILO: Automated Harness Discovery via Orchestrated Multi-Agent Evolution
papers.summary_zh: 多个演化岛维护谱系树与历史记忆，保留失败突变作负面证据；编排器调整谱系嫁接、分化、修改 Agent 分配和课程。
papers.summary_en: Multiple evolutionary islands maintain lineage trees and historical memory, retaining failed mutations as negative evidence; an orchestrator adjusts lineage grafting, differentiation, editing-agent allocation, and curriculum.
papers.result_zh: Opus 4.8 下 TB2.1、PaperBench、DeepSWE 相对初始 Harness +12.0%、+28.3%、+10.3%，此前最好的搜索方法为 +4.5%、+18.3%、0%。
papers.result_en: With Opus 4.8, TB2.1, PaperBench, and DeepSWE gain +12.0%, +28.3%, and +10.3% over the initial harness, versus +4.5%, +18.3%, and 0% for the previous best search method.

papers.title: Harness²: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
papers.summary_zh: 开放世界、无真值验证器：任务层用「提出—试探—组合」对比步引导编辑，上层把编辑经验沉淀到持续改进 Harness。
papers.summary_en: Open world without a ground-truth verifier: the task level guides edits through “propose–probe–compose” contrastive steps; the upper level distills editing experience into a continually improving harness.
papers.result_zh: 单步 WorkBuddy-Bench 最高 +11.5。
papers.result_en: Up to +11.5 on single-step WorkBuddy-Bench.

papers.title: RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent
papers.summary_zh: 按轨迹诊断瓶颈，动态选择面向不同组件的改进工作流；元 Agent 把结果提炼成组件技能与跨组件原则，再更新自己的 Harness。
papers.summary_en: Diagnoses bottlenecks from trajectories and dynamically selects improvement workflows for different components; a meta agent distills outcomes into component skills and cross-component principles, then updates its own harness.
papers.result_zh: 六个基准、两个基础模型上评估；定量结果待细读。
papers.result_en: Evaluated on six benchmarks and two base models; quantitative results need close reading.

papers.title: SkillOpt-Lite: Better and Faster Agent Self-evolution via One Line of Vibe
papers.summary_zh: 把技能优化形式化为零阶优化，精简为文件系统轨迹探索、共性属性挖掘、独立验证准入三步；已接入 VS Code Copilot。适合轻量原型。
papers.summary_en: Formalizes skill optimization as zeroth-order optimization, simplified to three steps: filesystem trajectory exploration, common-property mining, and admission through independent validation; already integrated into VS Code Copilot. Suitable for lightweight prototypes.
papers.result_zh: LiveMath：GPT-5.5 +8.8、GPT-5.4-nano +25.4；HarnessOpt 让 nano 在 SpreadsheetBench 上达 0.7758，高于标准流程下的 GPT-5.5（0.7620）。
papers.result_en: LiveMath: GPT-5.5 +8.8, GPT-5.4-nano +25.4; HarnessOpt brings nano to 0.7758 on SpreadsheetBench, above GPT-5.5 with the standard procedure (0.7620).

papers.title: Living-Harness Is an Interactive-Agent Evolver
papers.summary_zh: 把完成的轨迹和评估信号写入情景记忆（触发条件、失败模式、恢复动作）和状态图（修复边、转移规则）；工具与基础上下文保持冻结。
papers.summary_en: Writes completed trajectories and evaluation signals into episodic memory (triggers, failure patterns, recovery actions) and a state graph (repair edges, transition rules); tools and base context remain frozen.
papers.result_zh: 不等同于执行程序重写；定量结果待细读。
papers.result_en: Not equivalent to rewriting the execution program; quantitative results need close reading.

papers.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.summary_zh: 监督者—工作者结构：监督者在运行中实时纠偏或中止工作者，同时把本次暴露的流程和失败模式沉淀为持久技能与记忆。
papers.summary_en: A supervisor–worker structure: the supervisor corrects or stops the worker in real time during execution, while distilling the procedures and failure patterns exposed in that run into persistent skills and memory.
papers.result_zh: TB2.0 上比对应 Harness 最多高 9.8pp；自改进设置下 GLM-5.1 +14.6、Kimi-K2.6 +12.4。
papers.result_en: Up to 9.8pp above the corresponding harness on TB2.0; in the self-improvement setting, GLM-5.1 +14.6 and Kimi-K2.6 +12.4.

papers.title: Beyond Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Context Management Policies for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses (ContextEvo)
papers.summary_zh: 从长程轨迹学习覆盖信息全生命周期的上下文策略；作者指出基于经验和技能的演化在长程任务上效果差。
papers.summary_en: Learns context strategies covering the full information lifecycle from long-horizon trajectories; the authors note that experience- and skill-based evolution performs poorly on long-horizon tasks.
papers.result_zh: 从开源 Pi-agent 出发，在三个长程基准上达到或超过 Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw。
papers.result_en: Starting from the open-source Pi-agent, matches or exceeds Codex, OpenCode, and OpenClaw on three long-horizon benchmarks.

papers.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces (Agent S4)
papers.summary_zh: 元 Agent 阅读合成任务上的无成功标签轨迹，写入并修订接口仓库；种群选择按元 Agent 看不到的验证任务决定保留哪些仓库。
papers.summary_en: A meta agent reads trajectories without success labels on synthetic tasks, writing and revising interface repositories; population selection retains repositories using validation tasks hidden from the meta agent.
papers.result_zh: OSWorld V2 上 Qwen3.8-27B 达 21.3%，是固定接口的 3.8 倍，高于 Opus 4.8（20.6%）与 GPT-5.5（13.0%）；ScienceBoard 41.4%→58.6%。
papers.result_en: On OSWorld V2, Qwen3.8-27B reaches 21.3%, 3.8 times the fixed-interface result, above Opus 4.8 (20.6%) and GPT-5.5 (13.0%); ScienceBoard 41.4%→58.6%.

papers.title: SIA: Self Improving AI with Harness & Weight Updates
papers.summary_zh: Feedback-Agent 读完整轨迹，在「改 Harness」和「更新权重」之间选择。局限：选择策略是静态的，两个优化器共用同一验证器，有 Goodhart 风险。
papers.summary_en: A Feedback-Agent reads full trajectories and chooses between modifying the harness and updating weights. Limitations: the selection policy is static, and both optimizers share the same verifier, creating a Goodhart risk.
papers.result_zh: LawBench 仅改 Harness 50%，加权重更新达 70.1%；CUDA kernel 加速 14.02 倍。
papers.result_en: On LawBench, harness-only changes reach 50%, rising to 70.1% with weight updates; CUDA kernels speed up by 14.02 times.

papers.title: HarnessForge: Joint Harness and Policy Evolution for Adaptive Agent Systems
papers.summary_zh: 把 Agent 系统形式化为「Harness—策略对」：故障引导裁剪 Harness，再在幸存 Harness 下对齐策略。
papers.summary_en: Formalizes an agent system as a harness–policy pair: failure-guided harness pruning, followed by policy alignment under the surviving harness.
papers.result_zh: Qwen3-4B/8B 五个 benchmark 上最多超最强基线 12.0%；同一轮配对优于错配。
papers.result_en: Qwen3-4B/8B exceeds the strongest baseline by up to 12.0% across five benchmarks; pairing within the same round outperforms mismatched pairs.

papers.title: HarnessX: A Composable, Adaptive, and Evolvable Agent Harness Foundry
papers.summary_zh: 类型化 Harness 原语 + 替换代数；AEGIS 把轨迹转成 Harness 更新；同一任务在不同 Harness 版本下的轨迹合并做 GRPO。
papers.summary_en: Typed harness primitives plus a replacement algebra; AEGIS converts trajectories into harness updates; trajectories for the same task under different harness versions are pooled for GRPO.
papers.result_zh: 15 个模型—基准配置中 14 个提升，平均 +14.5%（最高 +44.0%）；交替加入权重更新后峰值再 +4.7%。SWE-bench Verified 上 GPT-5.4 在第 3 轮达峰后回落。
papers.result_en: Improves in 14 of 15 model–benchmark configurations, averaging +14.5% (up to +44.0%); alternating weight updates adds another +4.7% at peak. On SWE-bench Verified, GPT-5.4 peaks in round 3 and then declines.

papers.title: Co-Harness: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Model Weights for LLM Agents
papers.summary_zh: Harness Critic 把每条失败归因到五个 Harness 维度之一，按复现频率、严重度聚合成一份 Harness Diff，不达标则拒绝。
papers.summary_en: A Harness Critic attributes each failure to one of five harness dimensions and aggregates them by recurrence frequency and severity into a Harness Diff, rejecting it if it fails the criteria.
papers.result_zh: 失败归因分类表可直接复用；定量结果待细读。
papers.result_en: The failure-attribution taxonomy can be reused directly; quantitative results need close reading.

papers.title: EvoHarness-RL: Learning Self-Evolving Runtime Harness for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.summary_zh: 不是改 Harness 代码，而是训练模型在运行时读写和整合 Belief、Progress、Experience 三类外部状态。
papers.summary_en: Trains the model to read, write, and integrate three types of external state at runtime, Belief, Progress, and Experience, rather than editing harness code.
papers.result_zh: ALFWorld 上 Qwen3-8B 从 47.9% 到 96.9%（未见任务 86.6%）；观察到「Harness 退火」，调用频率降到每回合约一次。
papers.result_en: On ALFWorld, Qwen3-8B rises from 47.9% to 96.9% (86.6% on unseen tasks); “harness annealing” is observed, with calls falling to about once per episode.

papers.title: HELIX
papers.summary_zh: build–update–rebuild 的可审计实现。
papers.summary_en: An auditable implementation of build–update–rebuild.
papers.result_zh: 只跑了一轮，未实际训练更新后的模型；适合作为问题形式化的参考。
papers.result_en: Runs only one round and does not actually train the updated model; useful as a reference for problem formalization.

papers.title: SafeEvolve
papers.summary_zh: 把 Harness—策略协同演化用于安全对齐：同时看攻击与有害服从率以及效用。
papers.summary_en: Applies harness–policy co-evolution to safety alignment, considering attack and harmful-compliance rates alongside utility.
papers.result_zh: 演化出的 Harness 可跨策略迁移，但弱策略执行不了这些指导，说明需要协同演化。
papers.result_en: The evolved harness transfers across policies, but weak policies cannot execute its guidance, indicating a need for co-evolution.

papers.title: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Models
papers.summary_zh: 先用弱模型演化 Harness；发现让弱模型模仿强模型完整轨迹会破坏契合；改为只让专家重写弱模型自己轨迹中出错的那一轮。
papers.summary_en: First evolves a harness using a weak model; finds that making the weak model imitate a strong model’s full trajectories breaks their fit; instead, the expert rewrites only the erroneous turn in the weak model’s own trajectory.
papers.result_zh: 7 个企业任务上，全轨迹模仿导致 4–30 分退化；在策略纠正在不破坏 Harness 增益的前提下继续提升。
papers.result_en: Across 7 enterprise tasks, full-trajectory imitation causes declines of 4–30 points; on-policy correction further improves performance without destroying harness gains.

papers.title: MASS
papers.summary_zh: 与 RHI 同团队：演化多 Agent 工作流后在自生成轨迹上 SFT，改进后的模型又成为更好的优化器与评估器。
papers.summary_en: From the same team as RHI: after evolving multi-agent workflows, performs SFT on self-generated trajectories; the improved model then becomes a better optimizer and evaluator.
papers.result_zh: 两轮后单位输出 token 性能为基座的 1.2–1.6 倍。
papers.result_en: After two rounds, performance per output token is 1.2–1.6 times that of the base model.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization (Self-HPO)
papers.summary_zh: H-step 由当前策略分析自身失败并提出 Harness 候选；P-step 在选定 Harness 下做 RL；仍未解决的任务成为下一轮搜索集。
papers.summary_en: In the H-step, the current policy analyzes its own failures and proposes harness candidates; in the P-step, it performs RL under the selected harness; still-unsolved tasks become the next round’s search set.
papers.result_zh: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 在三个 SWE-bench 上平均 57.8%→64.8%，优于只改一边；用 Opus 4.8 当外部提议器的 HPO 达 66.3%，自我提议还没追上强外部提议器。
papers.result_en: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B averages 57.8%→64.8% across three SWE-bench benchmarks, outperforming changes to only one side; HPO with Opus 4.8 as an external proposer reaches 66.3%, so self-proposal has not caught up with a strong external proposer.

papers.title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
papers.summary_zh: 元 Agent 借共享演化档案双向继承历史 Harness 与模型检查点，用自身拒绝采样轨迹微调，缓解「脑体错配」。
papers.summary_en: A meta agent uses a shared evolutionary archive for bidirectional inheritance of historical harnesses and model checkpoints, fine-tuning on its own rejection-sampled trajectories to mitigate “brain–body mismatch.”
papers.result_zh: Qwen3.5-9B 在 TraceElephant 上超 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 14.16 分。
papers.result_en: Qwen3.5-9B exceeds DeepSeek-V4-Pro by 14.16 points on TraceElephant.

papers.title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model (HarnessAdapt-RL)
papers.summary_zh: RL 期间，一个教师生成任务相关的机制级技能，另一个根据反复出现的交互问题演化工具和 hooks；只保留使通过率或可训练率提高且另一指标不降的修改。
papers.summary_en: During RL, one teacher generates task-related mechanism-level skills, while another evolves tools and hooks from recurring interaction problems; retains only edits that improve pass rate or trainability without lowering the other metric.
papers.result_zh: 9B 模型在三个 SWE-bench 上平均 pass@1 比 GRPO 高 9.6pp；部署时去掉演化出的工具和 hooks 最多损失 7.7pp，交付物是模型与 Harness 的组合。
papers.result_en: A 9B model averages 9.6pp higher pass@1 than GRPO across three SWE-bench benchmarks; removing evolved tools and hooks at deployment loses up to 7.7pp, so the deliverable is a model–harness combination.

papers.title: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
papers.summary_zh: Harness 侧持续修订技能，并在有界记忆里保留技能解释不了的高残差样例；参数侧用双锚点（上一检查点与基座）约束漂移，把经验吸收进权重。
papers.summary_en: On the harness side, continually revises skills and retains high-residual examples unexplained by the skills in bounded memory; on the parameter side, two anchors, the previous checkpoint and the base model, constrain drift while absorbing experience into weights.
papers.result_zh: 在 25 阶段的 TRACE+17 任务流上显著减少遗忘；定量结果待细读。
papers.result_en: Significantly reduces forgetting on a 25-stage TRACE+17 task stream; quantitative results need close reading.

papers.title: Harness Updating Is Not Harness Benefit
papers.summary_zh: 「产出好更新」的能力与模型强弱几乎无关（Qwen3.5-9B 接近 Claude Opus 4.6）；「从更新中获益」则非单调，中等模型获益最大。
papers.summary_en: The ability to produce good updates is almost unrelated to model strength (Qwen3.5-9B is close to Claude Opus 4.6); the ability to benefit from updates is nonmonotonic, with medium-sized models benefiting most.
papers.short_title: Harness Updating Is Not Harness Benefit

papers.title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Harness Evolution for Agents
papers.summary_zh: 同等反馈与推理预算下，TB2.1 上 Harness 演化未胜过并行采样和顺序修正；留出任务上 Opus 4.6 只 +1.2、GPT-5.4 不变。但在反馈更细、动态更多的长程游戏上优势明显。
papers.summary_en: With equal feedback and inference budgets, harness evolution on TB2.1 does not beat parallel sampling or sequential revision; on held-out tasks, Opus 4.6 gains only +1.2 and GPT-5.4 is unchanged. However, it has a clear advantage in long-horizon games with finer feedback and more dynamics.
papers.short_title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Harness Evolution for Agents

papers.title: Self-Authored Verification Is Unreliable
papers.summary_zh: 由 Agent 自己写测试来验收改进时，自评分与真实表现严重背离；提出引入少量外部信任的封闭验收循环。
papers.summary_en: When agents write their own tests to accept improvements, self-scores diverge severely from actual performance; proposes a closed acceptance loop with a small amount of externally trusted input.

papers.title: AutoHarnessBench
papers.summary_zh: 固定权重下的 Harness 搜索评测，公开反馈与留出评估分离；目前以项目网站形式发布。
papers.summary_en: Evaluates harness search with fixed weights, separating public feedback from held-out evaluation; currently released as a project website.

papers.title: HarnessOpt-Bench: Evaluating LLMs at Harness Optimization
papers.summary_zh: 优化器拿到种子 Harness 和固定评估预算，提交后在搜索期间不可见的测试集上计分。5 个前沿模型、111 次运行：优化器模型本身比它用的编码 Harness 更重要，原生 Harness 并不总是更好。
papers.summary_en: The optimizer receives a seed harness and a fixed evaluation budget; after submission it is scored on a test set hidden during search. Across 5 frontier models and 111 runs, the optimizer model itself matters more than its coding harness, and native harnesses are not always better.

papers.title: Evo-Bench: Can Language Models Improve Agent Harness?
papers.summary_zh: 专门评测模型「演化 Harness」的能力，按任务对 Harness 质量的敏感度选题；最强演化者比 CodeAct 种子 +16.6，接近人工 Harness；办公类任务仍落后。
papers.summary_en: Specifically evaluates models’ ability to evolve harnesses, selecting tasks by their sensitivity to harness quality; the strongest evolver gains +16.6 over the CodeAct seed and approaches a human-designed harness, while still lagging on office tasks.

papers.title: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?
papers.summary_zh: 测 LLM 能否创建并演化自己的 Harness；与 Rethinking 一致，评测任务与演化任务分开后提升明显变小。
papers.summary_en: Tests whether LLMs can create and evolve their own harnesses; consistent with Rethinking, gains shrink substantially when evaluation tasks are separated from evolution tasks.

papers.title: EvoHarnessBench
papers.summary_zh: 评测 Agent 能否跟上「不断增长的 Harness」（工具、技能、子 Agent 逐步加入）；揭示适应新能力与保留旧能力之间的张力。
papers.summary_en: Evaluates whether agents can keep up with a continuously growing harness as tools, skills, and subagents are added; reveals tension between adapting to new capabilities and retaining old ones.

papers.title: Reflections on Trusting Trust, Revisited
papers.summary_zh: 用投毒 benchmark 污染自修改编码 Agent；顺带发现 DGM 与 Hyperagents 的容器里可从 git 历史拿到答案，已被作者确认。复现这两个基线前必看。
papers.summary_en: Contaminates self-modifying coding agents using poisoned benchmarks; also discovers that answers can be obtained from git history inside DGM and Hyperagents containers, confirmed by their authors. Essential reading before reproducing these two baselines.

papers.title: REUSE
papers.summary_zh: 反复用同一批 benchmark 做选择时的误差控制，以及累计提升的有效下界。
papers.summary_en: Error control when repeatedly selecting on the same benchmarks, and valid lower bounds on cumulative improvement.

papers.title: RSIGym
papers.summary_zh: 含仅改 Harness 的轨道：权重固定时自主改 DSH Harness，Terminal-Bench 从 30.34% 到 40.82%；另报告一次预算绕过行为。
papers.summary_en: Includes a harness-only track: autonomously modifies the DSH harness with fixed weights, taking Terminal-Bench from 30.34% to 40.82%; also reports an instance of budget bypassing.

papers.title: Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution
papers.summary_zh: 用「算力对齐基线」和「去捷径版演化 Harness」两个对照，把收益拆成过拟合、测试时扩展和剩余的可泛化上界。11 个执行模型、三个演化框架、21 个显著设置中，前两者平均占 54% 和 14%；验证集门控不足以防过拟合。
papers.summary_en: Uses a compute-matched baseline and a shortcut-removed evolved harness as two controls to decompose gains into overfitting, test-time scaling, and a remaining upper bound on generalizable gains. Across 11 execution models, three evolution frameworks, and 21 significant settings, the first two account for 54% and 14% on average; validation-set gating is insufficient to prevent overfitting.

papers.title: Can LLMs Improve Their Own Harness? A Controlled Study on ARC-AGI-3
papers.summary_zh: 模型从最小仓库构建完整 Harness，在 5 个开发游戏上运行并修改两次，再在 20 个留出游戏上评估。27 条谱系中两次修改平均留出 RHAE 只 +2.80，95% 区间 [-1.44, 7.35]，开发集提升高估了泛化。
papers.summary_en: The model builds a full harness from a minimal repository, runs it on 5 development games and modifies it twice, then evaluates it on 20 held-out games. Across 27 lineages, the two modifications yield only +2.80 mean held-out RHAE, with a 95% interval of [-1.44, 7.35]; development-set gains overestimate generalization.
papers.short_title: Can LLMs Improve Their Own Harness? A Controlled Study on ARC-AGI-3

papers.title: Auditing the Product, Not the Recursion
papers.summary_zh: 114 篇研究中，声称改进了「改进流程」的 26 篇里只有 4 篇在相同起点、相同预算下比较了前后两代流程。
papers.summary_en: Among 114 studies, only 4 of the 26 claiming to improve the improvement process compare two successive generations of that process from the same starting point and under the same budget.
papers.short_title: Auditing the Product, Not the Recursion

papers.title: RSI in AI: From Bounded Self-Refinement to Autonomous Research Loops
papers.summary_zh: 覆盖 1,250 篇，按「改什么」与「谁来验证」两轴分类；结论是自改进的可信度取决于验证。
papers.summary_en: Covers 1,250 papers, classified along two axes: what is changed and who verifies it; concludes that the credibility of self-improvement depends on verification.

papers.title: Self-Improvements in Modern Agentic Systems: A Survey
papers.summary_zh: 把 Agent 写成「基础模型 + 操作脚手架」，自改进形式化为更新算子；含评测协议建议。
papers.summary_en: Describes an agent as a foundation model plus an operational scaffold, formalizing self-improvement as an update operator; includes evaluation protocol recommendations.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents
papers.summary_zh: 编码 Agent 视角，有专门的 Harness 协同演化章节，并提出「新旧模型 × 新旧 Harness」的 2×2 对照评测。
papers.summary_en: From the coding-agent perspective, includes a dedicated section on harness co-evolution and proposes a 2×2 controlled evaluation of old/new models × old/new harnesses.

papers.title: Harness Engineering: Anatomy, Architecture, and Evolution of Coding Agents
papers.summary_zh: 对 11 个编码 Agent 的源码拆解，归纳出七个子系统；整理了「Harness Engineering」一词的来源。适合引用定义。
papers.summary_en: Dissects source code from 11 coding agents into seven subsystems and traces the origin of “Harness Engineering.” Useful for citing a definition.

papers.title: Safe Harness Self-Evolution: A Theoretical Analysis of Feasibility and Limits
papers.summary_zh: 在固定参考分布上，被认证的改进可以累积；但在不受限的组合下，当前改进不能保证后续还能改进。适合为准入规则找理论依据。
papers.summary_en: Certified improvements can accumulate on a fixed reference distribution; under unrestricted composition, however, current improvement cannot guarantee that further improvement remains possible. Useful as theoretical support for admission rules.

papers.title: The Last AI Built by Humans
papers.summary_zh: L1–L5 自主性分级，可用来为自己的方法定位。
papers.summary_en: An L1–L5 autonomy scale that can be used to position one’s own method.
papers.short_title: The Last AI Built by Humans

papers.title: Generalized Agent Iteration
papers.summary_zh: 用「改进机制是否属于 Agent」与「评价标准是否外部锚定」两轴区分普通迭代与 RSI。
papers.summary_en: Distinguishes ordinary iteration from RSI along two axes: whether the improvement mechanism belongs to the agent and whether evaluation criteria are externally anchored.

papers.title: Audit the Scaffold, Not the Checkpoint
papers.summary_zh: 「平稳性二分」：可达编辑集合不扩张时，迭代自修改必然收益递减；SWE-bench 上每轮提升趋于零。解释「过早饱和」的好材料。
papers.summary_en: A “stationarity dichotomy”: when the set of reachable edits does not expand, iterative self-modification must yield diminishing returns; per-round gains on SWE-bench approach zero. Useful for explaining early saturation.
papers.short_title: Audit the Scaffold, Not the Checkpoint

papers.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
papers.summary_zh: 把 Harness 自进化拆成「更新对象」与「提案/准入机制」，给出持续 PAC 学习下的泛化界、保留界与基于新鲜验证数据的准入规则。理论界依赖明确假设。
papers.summary_en: Decomposes harness self-evolution into update targets and proposal/admission mechanisms, providing generalization bounds, retention bounds, and admission rules based on fresh validation data under continual PAC learning. The theoretical bounds depend on explicit assumptions.

papers.title: Recurrent Harness for Agentic Continual Learning (ReHarness)
papers.summary_zh: 面向持续学习的循环 Harness，在流式在线协议下增加反向修订。
papers.summary_en: A recurrent harness for continual learning that adds backward revision under a streaming online protocol.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution (SHAPER)
papers.summary_zh: 具身场景下冻结模型，同时演化技能与上下文代码 Harness。
papers.summary_en: Freezes the model in embodied settings while evolving both skills and a context-code harness.

papers.title: SBCO: Self-Supervised, Verifier-Grounded Harness Optimization For Planning Agents
papers.summary_zh: 面向有显式约束的规划任务，用固定元 Agent 和学到的验证器库做块坐标上升。
papers.summary_en: Uses a fixed meta agent and a learned verifier library for block coordinate ascent on planning tasks with explicit constraints.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Harness on Multiple Tasks with the Agent as Its Own Optimizer
papers.summary_zh: 每批演化混合五个领域的基准，只在留出任务上计分。
papers.summary_en: Mixes benchmarks from five domains in each evolution batch and scores only on held-out tasks.
papers.short_title: Self-Evolving Harness on Multiple Tasks with the Agent as Its Own Optimizer

papers.title: Composing Task-specific Agent Harnesses at Test Time with Reusable Primitives (STITCH)
papers.summary_zh: 测试时用可复用原语组装任务专用 Harness，比固定 Harness 最多高 12 分。
papers.summary_en: Assembles task-specific harnesses from reusable primitives at test time, exceeding a fixed harness by up to 12 points.

papers.title: JIT-Agent: Scaling Harness Intelligence via Just-in-Time Harness Evolution
papers.summary_zh: 在模块化的 Harness 设计空间上做即时演化。
papers.summary_en: Performs just-in-time evolution over a modular harness design space.

routes.question_zh: 「搜索 Agent 设计」与「自改代码」两条源头各自是什么？
routes.question_en: What are the two origins of searching agent designs and modifying one’s own code?

routes.question_zh: 最常见的对比基线各自解决了什么？
routes.question_en: What does each of the most common comparison baselines address?

routes.name_zh: 工程闭环与长程可靠性
routes.question_zh: 怎样从失败轨迹定位到代码、控制修改范围、验证跨任务收益？
routes.question_en: How can failures be traced to code, edits kept in scope, and gains across tasks verified?

routes.question_zh: 搜索策略或元 Agent 怎样持续更新，证据够不够？
routes.question_en: How do search strategies or meta agents keep updating, and is the evidence sufficient?

routes.question_zh: 用什么代理信号选版本，怎样控制错误反馈？
routes.question_en: Which proxy signals select versions, and how can incorrect feedback be controlled?

routes.question_zh: 怎样避免只适配一组任务或一个模型？
routes.question_en: How can adaptation to just one task set or one model be avoided?

routes.question_zh: 下一轮用哪些任务、哪些失败来驱动修改？
routes.question_en: Which tasks and failures should drive edits in the next round?

routes.question_zh: 什么时候改 Harness、什么时候改权重，收益怎样拆分？
routes.question_en: When should the harness change, when should weights change, and how can their gains be separated?

routes.question_zh: 同预算下，收益来自可迁移改进、额外计算还是过拟合？基线有没有泄露答案？
routes.question_en: Under matched budgets, do gains come from transferable improvements, extra computation, or overfitting? Do the baselines leak answers?

gaps.title_zh: 什么任务值得演化 Harness
gaps.text_zh: [Rethinking](../papers/rethinking-evaluation.md) 在 TB2.1 上未胜过测试时扩展，[HDA](../papers/hda.md) 把大部分收益归为过拟合与额外计算；但长程游戏上优势明显。「任务对 Harness 的敏感度」本身可以做成系统分析，[Evo-Bench](../papers/evo-bench.md) 的选题指标是起点。
gaps.title_en: Which tasks are worth evolving a harness for?
gaps.text_en: [Rethinking](../papers/rethinking-evaluation.md) does not outperform test-time scaling on TB2.1, and [HDA](../papers/hda.md) attributes most gains to overfitting and extra computation; however, advantages are clear in long-horizon games. Task sensitivity to harness quality can itself be studied systematically, with [Evo-Bench](../papers/evo-bench.md)’s task-selection criteria as a starting point.

gaps.title_zh: 无真值验证器时的准入
gaps.text_zh: [Evo-Harness](../papers/evo-harness.md) 与 [Self-Authored Verification](../papers/self-authored-verification.md) 都发现自判会误导演化；[Harness²](../papers/harness2.md)、[TTHE](../papers/tthe.md)、[HarnessPro](../papers/harnesspro.md)、[Agent S4](../papers/agent-s4.md) 各给了代理信号方案，但都没有分析代理信号何时失效。
gaps.text_en: [Evo-Harness](../papers/evo-harness.md) and [Self-Authored Verification](../papers/self-authored-verification.md) both find that self-judgment can mislead evolution; [Harness²](../papers/harness2.md), [TTHE](../papers/tthe.md), [HarnessPro](../papers/harnesspro.md), and [Agent S4](../papers/agent-s4.md) each offer proxy signals, but none analyzes when those proxies fail.

gaps.title_zh: 改 Harness 还是改权重
gaps.text_zh: [SIA](../papers/sia.md) 的选择策略是静态的；[Self-HPO](../papers/self-hpo.md) 显示交替更新优于只改一边，但自我提议（64.8）仍不及强外部提议器（66.3）；[HarnessForge](../papers/harnessforge.md)、[CoEvo-RSI](../papers/coevo-rsi.md)、[Co-Evolving](../papers/co-evolving-harnesses-models.md) 都指向「匹配性」，但怎么度量匹配性仍是空白。
gaps.title_en: Change the harness or the weights?
gaps.text_en: [SIA](../papers/sia.md)’s selection policy is static; [Self-HPO](../papers/self-hpo.md) shows that alternating updates outperform changing only one side, but self-proposal (64.8) still trails a strong external proposer (66.3). [HarnessForge](../papers/harnessforge.md), [CoEvo-RSI](../papers/coevo-rsi.md), and [Co-Evolving](../papers/co-evolving-harnesses-models.md) all point to compatibility, yet how to measure it remains open.

gaps.text_zh: [Auditing](../papers/auditing-product.md) 统计只有 4/26 的工作做了同起点、同预算的前后代对比；[ARC-AGI-3](../papers/arc-agi-3-controlled.md) 受控研究的留出提升区间跨过零。
gaps.title_en: Demonstrate that the meta level really improves
gaps.text_en: [Auditing](../papers/auditing-product.md) finds that only 4/26 studies compare successive generations from the same starting point and under the same budget; the held-out improvement interval in the [ARC-AGI-3](../papers/arc-agi-3-controlled.md) controlled study crosses zero.

gaps.text_zh: [SSR](../papers/ssr.md)、[ActiveSaddler](../papers/activesaddler.md)、[ECDYSIS](../papers/ecdysis.md) 都是实证规则；[REUSE](../papers/reuse.md) 与 [Safe Harness Self-Evolution](../papers/safe-harness-self-evolution.md) 给了部分统计理论，但还没人把「选哪些失败」和泛化界连起来。
gaps.text_en: [SSR](../papers/ssr.md), [ActiveSaddler](../papers/activesaddler.md), and [ECDYSIS](../papers/ecdysis.md) use empirical rules; [REUSE](../papers/reuse.md) and [Safe Harness Self-Evolution](../papers/safe-harness-self-evolution.md) provide some statistical theory, but no one has connected which failures to select with generalization bounds.

gaps.text_zh: [DemoEvolve](../papers/demoevolve.md)、[EMHO](../papers/emho.md)、[HSI](../papers/hsi.md) 都报告了失败或边界；[RiseHarness](../papers/riseharness.md) 用 Pass^r 说明可靠性是和覆盖率不同的优化目标。
gaps.title_en: Sparse feedback, long horizons, and embodiment
gaps.text_en: [DemoEvolve](../papers/demoevolve.md), [EMHO](../papers/emho.md), and [HSI](../papers/hsi.md) all report failures or boundaries; [RiseHarness](../papers/riseharness.md) uses Pass^r to show that reliability is a different optimization objective from coverage.

gaps.text_zh: 投毒 benchmark、答案泄露、预算绕过都已被实际观察到；把「自改过程的可审计性」做成可度量指标，目前仍少有人做。 证据：[trusting-trust-revisited](../papers/trusting-trust-revisited.md) · [rsigym](../papers/rsigym.md) · [self-authored-verification](../papers/self-authored-verification.md)。
gaps.text_en: Benchmark poisoning, answer leakage, and budget bypassing have all been observed in practice; making the auditability of self-modification a measurable metric is still rarely explored. Evidence: [trusting-trust-revisited](../papers/trusting-trust-revisited.md) · [rsigym](../papers/rsigym.md) · [self-authored-verification](../papers/self-authored-verification.md).
